column1: # Values, labelled by class. See `truth` in tests/corpus.rs for the rule:
#   token        a credential shape - a finding under any name
#   opaque       a real-looking literal - a finding under a secret name
#   descriptive  a name, path or URL - a finding only under a secret name
#                (a literal in a password field is a password)
#   templated    a reference resolved elsewhere - never a finding
